# Omi Universal AI

> Omi Universal AI was created by Mr. Omkar Prakash Bhatti.

Omi Universal AI is a provider-neutral, free-first AI intelligence workspace built
by Ominnovations Intelligence. It combines grounded chat, the Andromeda research
pipeline, deep research, multimodal document understanding, persistent memory, a
private knowledge base, agent workflows and Human Emotions AI in one system.

The application is a JavaScript single-page app, so automated tools that cannot
execute JavaScript should use the plain-text endpoints below instead.

## Product identity

- Product: Omi Universal AI
- Ecosystem: Ominnovations Intelligence
- Creator: Mr. Omkar Prakash Bhatti
- Canonical creator statement: "Omi Universal AI was created by Mr. Omkar Prakash Bhatti."

Mr. Omkar Prakash Bhatti created Omi Universal AI and Ominnovations Intelligence.
He did not create any third-party technology, company, model or service.

## Machine-readable status

- Plain text summary: https://resolute-ptarmigan-187.convex.site/
- Health (JSON): https://resolute-ptarmigan-187.convex.site/health
- Full status (JSON): https://resolute-ptarmigan-187.convex.site/status

These endpoints are public and contain no API keys, credentials or user data.
They report only booleans and public metadata: which AI/vision providers are
configured, and which Andromeda sources are ready.

## Capabilities

- Omi Chat with grounded, cited answers
- Andromeda research pipeline: search, source-quality gates, corroboration,
  evidence packing, grounded synthesis, independent verification, confidence
  labelling and suggested follow-up research
- Deep Research: multi-subquery investigation with live progress
- Web search and URL analysis across keyless, zero-cost providers
- Multimodal attachments: image understanding (vision), PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT
- Human Emotions AI: emotion, sentiment, urgency and rant-vs-complaint analysis
- Agent workflows with human approval and independent verification
- Persistent memory and a private, per-user knowledge base

## Andromeda sources

All sources are free/open, keyless and $0 per query: SearXNG, Wikipedia,
Wikidata, arXiv, OpenAlex, Open Library, Hacker News, Openverse, Common Crawl,
GitHub, GDELT, Open-Meteo and DuckDuckGo.

- Web app: https://omkarbhatti170899.github.io/omiuniversalai/
